# Published reference values

`reference_values.json` holds numbers transcribed from the test suite of
[meyerjp3/psychometrics](https://github.com/meyerjp3/psychometrics) (Apache-2.0,
© J. Patrick Meyer), which in turn reports results of STUIRT (Kolen), POLYEQUATE
(Kolen), Equating Recipes (Brennan et al.), R `psych::guttman`, R `GPArotation`
and R `mirt` (LSAT7, Bock & Lieberman 1970). Only numeric reference values and the
public LSAT7 response patterns are used; no Java (Apache-2.0) or jMetrik (GPL-2.0)
source code was copied. PsikoAnaliz implementations are clean-room from the cited
publications. Each block records its source and tolerance.
